string.text: Greybox structural foundation, 2.5 x 2.5 m. Place it freely; further foundations snap to its edges.
Greybox structural wall, 2.5 m wide and 3 m tall. Snaps to foundation and roof edges and to other walls.
Greybox wall with a 1.2 x 2.2 m opening. Snaps like a regular wall.
Greybox flat roof / ceiling panel, 2.5 x 2.5 m. Snaps to wall tops and to other roof panels.
